== Trivia ==
* During early development, a similar skill called 'Feeding' existed, which healed the pet for dealing damage for the next 5 seconds, as mentioned by an alpha tester in the Photics e-zine Issue #5<ref>https://photics.com/issues/issue05.pdf</ref>.
* The [[skill icon]] was previously used for the skill [[Call of Elemental Protection]], which gave additional armor against elemental damage. That might explain why the hyena on the skill icon is standing in a flame.
